title: Distance as area under a velocity graph
caption: The distance travelled is the area under the velocity graph v = 3t² from t = 0 to 4. An antiderivative is t³, so the area is 4³ − 0³ = 64 m.
alt: The parabola v = 3t² from 0 to 4 s, rising to 48 m/s, with the area under it shaded and labelled 64 m.
description: Distance is the area under the velocity–time graph from 0 to 4.

checks.name: the area under 3t² from 0 to 4 is 4³ = 64 m
